V-222387.justification: UDS includes a deny-new-session limiter, but actual Core default SSO_SESSION_MAX_PER_USER=0 is unlimited. The session limiter is implemented by Core; only Gallatin policy value and applied operator configuration remain. Human review on 2026-11-10 confirmed Needs work; one concurrent session per user is the proposed maximum, pending policy approval and configuration.
V-222387.next_step: Gallatin security confirms the proposed maximum of one concurrent session per user. Gallatin SRE sets realmInitEnv.SSO_SESSION_MAX_PER_USER to the approved positive value and updates the existing uds-user-session-count authenticator config through AdminConsole/API where needed. Verify the applied realm enforces the approved maximum. The proposed value of 1 is not yet an approved or applied configuration. No Horizon session-limiter code is needed.
